_comment: Read by scripts/ci-hash.py. implicit_dependencies: targets the tests run without linking. extra_inputs: files and folders the tests read from outside their own (scripts/ci-hash.py check-reads finds them and fails for one that is missing). logic / os_dependent: the split (docs/design/ci-lean.md); a target in neither list is treated as OS-dependent.

os_dependent.CLITests: runs the built binary; its tests choose paths by Vision, CoreML, Speech, AVFoundation and macOS-only backup (#if canImport in CLIRecognize*, CLIVideo, CLITranscribe, CLIBackup)
os_dependent.SempereAppCoreTests: VaultLibrary and the lifecycle tests use Glibc or Darwin file locking
os_dependent.SempereCaptureTests: the outbox and the received set use FileIO (Glibc, Musl or Darwin calls); the muxer's AVFoundation check is macOS-only (#if canImport)
os_dependent.SempereLocalizationTests: Apple only: Package.swift does not build it on Linux
os_dependent.SempereNotabilityTests: its CLI tests run the built binary; Vision, macOS-only real-file tests
os_dependent.SempereRenderTests: Vision, CoreML, PDFKit, PencilKit parity checks, font file access, FoundationXML and JavaScriptCore branches
os_dependent.SempereTests: FileIO, VaultFileLock, WriteLedger, VaultTrust, BlobCache and FinderBundleBit pick Glibc, Musl or Darwin calls
os_dependent.SempereWebDAVTests: the transport (FoundationNetworking on Linux, URLSession on Darwin), FolderRemote, the slow HTTP server
